Symbols:
  \nu_{N}: Nitrate uptake rate [mol N mol C^-1 time^-1] (computed)
  Q_{nm}: Maximum cellular nitrogen quota [mol N mol C^-1] (parameter)
  Q_{n}: Total N:C ratio [mol N mol C^-1] (computed)
  q_{n}: Minimum cellular nitrogen quota [mol N mol C^-1] (parameter)
  \nu_{nm}: Maximum nitrate uptake rate [mol N mol C^-1 time^-1] (parameter)
  S_{NO3}: Concentration of nitrate as N in the reactor [mol N m^{-3}] (computed)
  S_{NO3_0}: Initial extracellular nitrate concentration [mol N m^-3] (variable)
  X_{N}: Concentration of cellular nitrogen as N [mol N m^{-3}] (computed)
  X_{C}: Total biomass carbon concentration [mol C m^{-3}] (variable)
  X_{cd}: Concentration of functional biomass (algal biomass excluding carbohydrates and neutral lipids) as C [mol X_{cd}-C m^{-3}] (computed)
  P: Photosynthesis rate normalized to functional biomass [mol C (mol X_{cd}-C)^{-1} d^{-1}] (computed)
  m: Functional biomass degradation rate [time^-1] (parameter)
  X_{carb}: Concentration of carbohydrates as C [mol X_{carb}-C m^{-3}] (computed)
  m_{c}: Respiration rate constant adjusted for photoinhibition of respiration. (parameter)
  k_{mc}: Light-inhibition coefficient in the exponential adjustment to carbohydrate respiration. (parameter)
  I_{avg_R}: Average reference light intensity over the optical path without attenuation by biomass [mol photons m^{-2} d^{-1}] (computed)
  m_{cN}: Coefficient scaling nitrogen-uptake-associated carbohydrate consumption. [-] (parameter)
  \beta: Coefficient scaling nitrogen-uptake-associated neutral-lipid synthesis. [-] (parameter)
  k_{nl}: Light-response coefficient in the exponential term for nitrogen-uptake-associated neutral-lipid synthesis. (parameter)
  I_{avg}: Average light intensity inside the reactor, averaged over the optical path [mol photons m^{-2} d^{-1}] (computed)
  q_{nl}: Rate portion of carbon redirection from carbohydrate to lipid accumulation [unitless] (computed)
  X_{nl}: Concentration of neutral lipids as C [mol X_{nl}-C m^{-3}] (computed)
  X_{chl}: Concentration of Chl-a as C [mol X_{chl}-C m^{-3}] (computed)
  \theta: Maximum Chl-a:N ratio. [-] (parameter)
  k_{chl}: Light-adaptation coefficient in the exponential regulation of chlorophyll-a synthesis. (parameter)
  m_{chl}: Chl-a degradation rate [time^-1] (computed)

Model-wide assumptions (already recorded, do not repeat):
  - Optical cross‑section parameters a and b are taken as constant regardless of cultivation conditions.
  - The composition of functional biomass is fixed to CH1.8O0.5N0.2.
  - Nitrate uptake is assumed to equal the nitrate removed from the medium.

laws.description: Computes nitrate uptake as a nitrate-concentration-scaled rate whose maximum is regulated by the cellular nitrogen quota.
laws.quote: As a result, the nitrate uptake rate $ v_{N} $ in eq 17 is linearly related to the extracellular nitrate concentration $ S_{NO3} $ and is divided by the initial concentration $ S_{NO3\_{0}} $ to offset the effect of initial nitrate level. Additionally, the maximum nitrate uptake rate $ v_{nm} $ is regulated by the nitrogen quota to potentially limit the maximum amount of nitrogen that cells can assimilate.
laws.law_type_reason: It specifies nitrate-uptake kinetics as a function of extracellular nitrate and cellular nitrogen quota.

laws.description: Defines the total cellular nitrogen quota as intracellular nitrogen concentration divided by total biomass carbon concentration.
laws.law_type_reason: It defines the nitrogen quota as a ratio of two concentrations.

laws.description: Balances functional biomass carbon through photosynthetic production and functional biomass degradation.
laws.law_type_reason: It gives the rate of change of functional biomass as production minus loss.

laws.description: Balances carbohydrate carbon through carbon allocation, respiration, nitrogen-uptake-associated consumption, and redirection to lipids.
laws.law_type_reason: It gives the rate of change of carbohydrate carbon as the sum of production and consumption terms.

laws.description: Balances neutral-lipid carbon through nitrogen-uptake-associated synthesis and carbon redirected from carbohydrate accumulation.
laws.law_type_reason: It gives the rate of change of neutral-lipid carbon from its synthesis terms.

laws.description: Balances chlorophyll-a carbon through light-regulated synthesis associated with nitrogen uptake and chlorophyll degradation.
laws.law_type_reason: It gives chlorophyll-a accumulation as synthesis minus degradation.

laws.description: Computes the decline in reactor nitrate concentration due to nitrate uptake.
